simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גֹּמֶד (H1574) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: גֹּמֶד (gômed) means properly, a span First listed occurrence: Judg 3 16.

definitions.full: H1574. gomed גֹּ֫מֶד noun masculine cubit (from elbow to knuckles of clenched (contracted) hand; Aq on Ezek 27:11 , Ra and others; Greek πυγμή ; Late Hebrew גּוֺמֶד cubit ; so Aramaic גַּרְמִידָא ChWB 1. 155 , (lexicons)) — Judg 3:16 of Ehud's sword ׳ג אָרְכָּהּ (see GFM).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root apparently meaning to grasp;
